figures.caption: Figure 1: Constant step size NPG on a randomly generated finite-horizon tabular MDP: (a) error vs. iteration at h = 1; (b) error vs. all horizons at fixed iteration T = 100, where x-axis is on linear scale and y-axis is on logarithmic scale. In the plots, the solid (blue) curve shows the empirical error, and the dashed (red) curve shows the theoretical upper bound.

Figure 2: Increasing step size NPG on the structured instance with ϑρ = H, under the horizon-only robust schedule of Corollary 1: (a) error vs. iteration at h = 1; (b) error vs. all horizons at fixed iteration T = 20. Both plots use linear x-axis and log-scale y-axis. The solid (blue) curve shows the empirical error, and the dashed (red) curve shows the corresponding geometric reference curve, which is undefined at h = H where ϑρ = 1.

Figure 3: Increasing step size NPG on the randomly generated MDP under the problem-dependent ϑρ > 1 bound of Theorem 2: (a) error vs. iteration at h = 1; (b) error vs. all horizons at fixed iteration T = 20. Both plots use linear x-axis and log-scale y-axis. The solid (blue) curve shows the empirical error, and the dashed (red) curve shows the corresponding geometric reference curve, which is undefined at h = H where ϑρ = 1.
